FN-SHKV88-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 163
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 163 as introduced allows for the use of federally accepted alternative refrigerants to
be used in various appliances. This will not directly affect state or local funding.
